text: The application seems at first to be the perfect, ideal application until you start saying things that it might not like. At that point, it will start listening to what you are saying and try to advise or direct you another way, thereby completely and 100% voiding its own purpose of being something for writing what we want it to write. I wholeheartedly give it a one star and caution other users, as it is listening unduly to you and censoring your ability of speech.
